The regional standard specifies net areas for individual rooms and functions; it provides no verified minimum gross property area, so those room standards cannot establish overall area sufficiency. A feasibility assessment should verify the applicable requirements and checks, including Turin planning compatibility, change of use, health and safety, accessibility, and sector authorization.
